card.title: Export workspace as plugin
card.body: Bundle your agents, skills and, optionally, eval cases and learnings into a .zip that another workspace can import.
card.emptyHint: Create an agent or a skill first: there is nothing to export yet.

lastExport.label: Last export:
lastExport.counts: · {skills, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} · {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}

dialog.title: Export workspace as plugin
dialog.intro: Choose what goes into the plugin file. Saved keys, tokens and run history are never exported.

name.label: Plugin name
name.hint: Optional. Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, 1–64 characters. Left empty, the name is devdigest- followed by the workspace name.
name.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (for example team-reviews), at most 64 characters.

skills.heading: Skills
skills.note: Skills linked to a selected agent are always included.

selection.none: Select at least one agent or skill.

dialog.loadFailed: Agents and skills could not be loaded, so nothing can be exported yet.
